 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The San Francisco 49ers will face the Dallas Cowboys in Week 10 without their No. 1 receiver, while multiple players injury status will be determined closer to gametime.
 San Francisco will be without wide receiver Mike Evans for a fourth consecutive week after he was officially ruled out for Sunday's game against Dallas. Evans continues to recover from a right Achilles tendonitis injury that he suffered in a Week 6 win against the Washington Commanders.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Evans has had a productive year, in the moments he's on the field. Through six games, the 33-year-old receiver has 27 receptions for 420 yards and 3 touchdowns. However, his absence has also provided opportunities for other receivers on the depth to get a chance to shine.
 Last week, 49ers wideout Jordan Watkins had a breakout game with four catches, 86 yards and a touchdown. At the trade deadline, San Francisco acquired veteran receiver Keenan Allen in a trade with the Indianapolis Colts to bolster a WR room that's dealt with injuries all year long.
 On the bright side, San Francisco running back Christian McCaffrey (rest), defensive back Siran Neal (knee, foot), wide receiver Demarcus Robinson (ankle) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) were all no longer listed on the injury report against the Cowboys .
 Speaking of injuries, Evans is the only 49er listed out on the team's report. Other players are questionable leading up to kickoff. Here's the San Francisco 49ers injury report for Week 10 against the Cowboys:

The Colts debuted their "Anvil Strike" uniform - featuring an unfamiliar gray uniform and glossy, metallic blue helmet with the familiar horseshoe logo in white. The Colts won, 19-17, for their first win of the season.

For the game, the Bills debuted their "Nickel City" alternate uniforms - the most striking element being the blue "Charge Helmet," adorned simply with an oversized cutout of the team's familiar logo. The Bills won the game, 24-16 .

(Doug Engle, Florida Times-Union, USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co) Week 2: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford (9) hands the ball to running back Kyren Williams (23) during a 28-6 win on "Monday Night Football" against the New York Giants at SoFi Stadium. The Rams debuted their new "Classic Sol" uniforms, an homage to the team's look during its 1951 championship season.

The Cowboys wore their "Arctic White" uniforms for the 37-20 win. The Cardinals wore their desert-themed "Rivalries" uniforms in the 31-7 loss to the Seahawks. Arizona's "Rivalries" look was one of the best to debut in 2025 .
 (Matt Kartozian, IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect) Week 2: The Baltimore Ravens' Trey Hendrickson (91) reacts after a sack against the New Orleans Saints at M&T Bank Stadium. The Ravens wore their "White Noise" uniforms, just one of the team's new uniform combinations that will debut during the 2026 season. The Ravens lost the game, 24-17.
